reviews.title: great airline
reviews.text: Seat space is the same as RyanAir. So it's not a lot of space but still ok. The staff was super friendly and humorous. We started on time. The only real problem is that there is no possibility to buy sandwiches or pastries. You can really only buy chips or sweets. There are still Noodle Cups but unfortunately they were sold out on our flight. You can pre-order food for the flight but how do you know what you want to eat in a week or two, we had a morning flight so we would have had our lunch at around 10.30am, well who eats lunch at that time please? For this reason we did not pre-order food However, after it was morning I would have liked to buy a sandwich or something but after they had nothing I had no choice, only eat chips because I was really super hungry. This is really the first airline I've seen where you can't buy anything. Furthermore, you should explain the tax-free shopping better, you get a link for Airahopping before you leave, where you can pre-order something, but it doesn't say when the last day is to order. So we wanted to order various things before we left, unfortunately we couldn't because it was 3 days before departure and the order was apparently too late. This is very confusing
reviews.author: Angie E

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Never again will we fly with Sunclass airways,they have the smallest seats in the world,worst food in the world half the passengers arrived at Oslo without their luggage which we were never told about until we arrived even though the crew knew about it before we left Phuket,no information whatsoever Food (and I,m being kind calling it food)a stale baguette with two slices of something and a piece of lettuce,the lady next to us paid extra for hers and it was the same as ours except it came in a box,disgusting was what she called it, Ving as a serious travel agent should be ashamed to offer their customers this kind of service, God only knows when we get our luggage back,Never again
reviews.author: Alanoslo

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: Sunclass Airlines damaged my suitcase. And draw 50% of price in compansation for the damages they cosed. It's a berly used suitcase and for 45euros you can not buy a new one in the same quality and size. The on board service was ok, but noting extra ordinary, taxfree sales was sold out before they reached the middle of the plane. So if you want to but taxfree you need to buy yourself a seat in the front of the plane.
reviews.author: Marianne A

reviews.title: Sunclass airlines performs under par in almost all areas.
reviews.text: Sunclass airlines performs under par in almost all areas. Delays, both flight and luggage (both ways) seat confort, food etc is all well below average.
reviews.author: Bryggern

reviews.title: Best staff and service
reviews.text: we have travelled a lot! And this was our first time flying with sunclass airlines and we were so impressed with the service and the staff.
reviews.author: Angela Lea

reviews.title: A Fantastic airline!
reviews.text: Recommend, the seats are comfy and it was a smooth takeoff and a smooth landing! Staff was very pleasant, helpful and understanding. They gave us instructions in English and in Norwegian! I have flown with many airlines and Sunclass must take the top! Clean cabins, enjoyable seats, alright food and a overall good experience. Will be back as soon as possible! No hidden fees! Gotta love ‘em
reviews.author: Ingemar R
reviews.route: Trondheim - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Absolute shitfest
reviews.text: Wouldnt recommend this garbage if it was the only airlines available. Buying one 24kg luggage, couldnt print, only able to print the other 6? Wherever the f*** those even came from. Luckily for me, they couldnt be scanned nor sent through the bag drops so I got to investigate. Fortunately on the machine, I was advised to contact an non exsisting agent. After 2 hours of this s*** fiesta, I got moved by the beloved Sola to the wrong queue where I waited 30 more minutes only to be moved to an even longer one because I didnt in fact own a gold s*** card. Now 30 minutes in after 2.5 hours worth of s***, Im still waiting in this queue, writing a review. Who knows, maybe I get my vacation today, like what more can go wrong :)
reviews.author: Filip H

reviews.title: Nice flight
reviews.text: Very nice plane. Good space at row 25. We paied extra to have premium breakfast and it was very good.
reviews.author: Henrik B
reviews.route: Copenhagen - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Spacious seats, friendly cabin crew, clean interior and screens in front of seats. The flights were delayed but we got free sandwiches for the delay. You cannot do internet check-in in advance; you must go to regular check-in at the airport as well. So you only waste time by doing it on internet. The vegetarian food was small and not so tasty.
reviews.author: Nea H

reviews.title: Not a single  word of English spoken!
reviews.text: If you don’t speak Danish don’t fly with them! On the way back from my vacation in Greece, the flight had to wait one hour before departure and all that information was only communicated in Danish! It was the same on the first flight (coming to Greece) nothing was communicated in English. The company just assumes that everyone using their services speaks Danish…
reviews.author: Alex T

reviews.title: Disrespectful and racist
reviews.text: All the announcements during the flight, even including safety instructions, are performed in Swedish. Absolutely disrespectful and racist agains other passengers who does not speak Scandinavian languages. It is said if you do not understand Swedish, you need to contact crew for help. Imagine you are the only person on the flight then and you supposed to do what exactly?! - rase your hand and demand safety instructions for you only to be performed in English? Since when this became acceptable?! Absolutely unacceptable policy!
reviews.author: Olga S

reviews.title: Modern planes with comfortable seating
reviews.text: The staff on this airline were nice, the seats are comfortable, there is enough legroom and room for luggage in the overhead bins, the air condition works, nice displays that show entertainment as well as a map and statistics of the plane. Both ways HEL-RHO and back the plane departed early and landed early. Only minus I give is the fact that they placed me and my girlfriend on different rows while coming back home and we could not change it during online check-in.
reviews.author: uttnoT

reviews.title: Precise and accurate
reviews.text: The entire flight was carried out in a clean and orderly fashion. The crew was friendly and helpful. There was served a tasty meal for the Economy Plus passengers that were in the front of the plane. The only problem that I found was the public announcements that were mumbled and were largely useless. Trying to use headphones during the announcements did not help at all since no sound came through at all. Not very satisfying for such a new Airbus.
reviews.author: Brian S

reviews.title: A pleasant ride
reviews.text: You did not noticed the flight duration at 7,5h. We got the entertainmentkit and watched several movies. They served dinner and later also a sandwich.
reviews.author: Eva-Maria K

reviews.title: Away again
reviews.text: We go to Gran Canaria many times originally using Thomas Cook and now Sunclass. Staff always courtious and friendly. We book as a package so never have any problems with checking and the service always as described Only critism would be seating space although having now lost some weight perhaps not a problem when we travel again..
reviews.author: Alan C
reviews.route: Stavanger - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: LPA-OSL: The food is quite good
reviews.text: The flight from Gran Canaria to Oslo was around one hour delayed. The food was quite good and much better than food we have eaten in some of the flights we have had with Norwegian at long distance flights. The seats are very uncomfortable for a flight of around five hours duration. The service was very good. Average minus because of uncomfortable seats. Look for more reviews by MulleEllum.
reviews.author: MulleEllum
reviews.route: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria - Oslo

reviews.title: OSL-LPA: The seats are uncomfortable
reviews.text: The flight from Oslo to Las Palmas was OK. The seats were too short and hard for the duration of the flight. The food OK, but a little too salty. The service was quite good. Average minus because of the uncomfortable seats. Look for more reviews by MulleEllum.
reviews.author: MulleEllum
reviews.route: Oslo - Las Palmas de Gran Canaria

reviews.title: Good service and spot on time
reviews.text: We enjoyed the service and the quality of the Premiun class. Verry profetional staff and good entertainmet system helps you on this 12 hours flight
reviews.author: JSteen2013

reviews.title: delay-delay-delay
reviews.text: delay in Oslo one hour before boarding, then we enter airplane wait for 2 additional hours for oil check. Stewardess are not offer any water or cafe in this waiting time. Food was eatable but i stay away since it was not good. Delay in Cabo Verde for 1 hour waiting for co pilot. Christmas eve and nothing special offer or something complementary.
reviews.author: Bribir051

reviews.title: Poor service with no basic medical skills and no knowledge of food allergies
reviews.text: If you are suffering from any disease or food allergy this company is not for you!! Our group had persons with diabetes and glutein free diet. None of this were taking into count even we paid extra for this (special meals etc.). No coffee or tea were served (ran out suddenly) and you had to pay for basically everything. Arrogant staff and horrible food (yes, we paid extra for special food), also no any "blankets" available during night flights. We can't recomment to anyone!!
reviews.author: Elisa

reviews.title: Thomas Cook Airlines
reviews.text: «Thomas Cook Airlines» Remember this name, make a note or even draw this name.. but Never! Never travel with this company! The most rude, aggressive and unprofessional crew I’ve ever seen! The plane was dirty with some white spots on the seats. Cabin crew is late with food and drinks distribution, because very busy with market salings.. nobody reacting on assistance button call at all! Cabin crew kicking your elbows when passing rapid between seats without any reaction and apologies. And I have personal story (incident) what happened to me and my friends during the flight from Stockholm to Punta Cana on 3rd December when cabin crew was ignoring passengers and cocked my elbow while I was eating so the food scattering on me and cabin crew didn’t stop to take a look what happened and advised to keep my hands in some spacial position when eat when I complained regarding that incident. And another one incident on happened on our way from Punta Cana to Copenhagen on 17th December when one of cabin crew didn’t trust to my friend that he turned his mobile to flight mode already. She was maximum rude and aggressive! Was shouting on my friend and most terrible the chief cabin crew was covering her colleague and just was trolling and spoke mockingly with us. In the end of flight Chief of cabin crew refused to give us the name of aggressive crew and told that her Scandinavian culture is different from my and my friends and that we must follow their rules and culture. Then guilty cabin cr
reviews.author: Nazar

reviews.title: Excellent crew
reviews.text: Great service, tasty meals, on time-flights, professional crew. I would be more than happy to recommend flying with Sunclass airlines!
reviews.author: Marianne80f

reviews.title: It was ok
reviews.text: Thomas Cook .. Nothing left to say ☹️I am considering my self luck I got back three days before it all went wrong
reviews.author: Gary T

reviews.title: Worse company ever !
reviews.text: We took a 1am flight to go back to London from Dalaman and was such a disaster. Staff rude and disorganized my flight and previous flight were in late and staff didn't even put an announcement or apologised . They charged us extra 70 pounds for 2 kg extra on hand luggage. Wasn't specified properly on website that the 8 kg was the total weight including hand luggage and handbag! 70 pounds was a proper robbery! Never again!
reviews.author: Gloria G

reviews.title: Delay - without information
reviews.text: We were told that we could not take off fully fueled. So, we had to fly for 35 min. and land in Kavala (Greece). That gave us a delay, but that was not the issue. The issue was that the delay was not reported back to Copenhagen, so the people that where in the airport to pick us up had to wait for over 1 hour. 100 dkr. in extra parking. Where they could have stayed at home, and left an hour later.
reviews.author: Daydream785281

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We travelled with Thomas Cook Airlines on our annual summer holiday to Bulgaria. The planes to and from Varna were clean and the staff were helpful and smiling and some of them even spoke Danish! We had ordered a special breakfast and it turned out that part of drinks weren't supplied but when questioned about it after arrival at our destination they promised to supply them on the homeward journey - which they did without having to be reminded. We were impressed that our email correspondence had reached the cabin crew. We didn't question the missing drinks on the spot because we weren't sure whether they were included or not. Both flights were punctual. We had emergency exit seats, so plenty of leg space.
reviews.author: Vivien W

reviews.title: Thomas Cook Airlines Scandinavia
reviews.text: Thomas Cook Airlines Scandinavia and its staff was a disaster!!! No help what-so-ever! Lady with new born.....And the one sitting in Exit row - naked guy sitting - no questions asked on how to he would "perform" if necessary - us sitting in Exit row...us they asked - the same question - 3 times...what a JOKE!!!
reviews.author: Stefan O

reviews.title: New concept introduced
reviews.text: Well, we all know most what these flight has to offer and they are very much the same experience from one flight to another. The airplanes are ok, seats are ok and so are the leg rooms too. Please note that it’s possible to reserve seats with more leg rooms. Anyway - what was news to us at this flight was the new concept introduced for the food. It was surprisingly well made and much simplified with a new tray. Less stuff. The food experience was very positive, new thinking, layout and simplified. Personnel do always their best to provide service. The multimedia offered a good verity of films, tv channels and music to mention some.
reviews.author: se50820

reviews.title: Works  for me
reviews.text: A friendly flightcrew doing all in their power to give service. They gave quality to the travellers better than som other chartercompanies.
reviews.author: trollstugan

reviews.title: Thomas Cook meets ones expectations
reviews.text: Both on the forward trip and the return trip I was very statisfied with the cleaness and support of the staff onboard, all was excelltn. Itinerary was kept as scheduled, well done.
reviews.author: Harry J
